## Objective

Describe the security improvement.

> Do not publish passwords, API keys, tokens or exploitable sensitive details in a public issue.

## Tasks

- [ ] Identify the affected component
- [ ] Apply the security improvement
- [ ] Add or update tests if relevant

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The security requirement is addressed
- [ ] No sensitive information is exposed
- [ ] Existing features still work correctly
